token=apis.venmo.login(username='paul_mill@gmail.com', password='S1OmnLn')['access_token']

# fetch all pending payment requests (paginate)
all_pending=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page=apis.venmo.show_received_payment_requests(access_token=token,status='pending',page_index=page_index,page_limit=page_limit)
    print('Fetched page',page_index,'len',len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    all_pending.extend(page)
    page_index+=1

print('Total pending',len(all_pending))
# verification artifact: ids and created_at sorted by created_at desc
pending_sorted=sorted(all_pending,key=lambda x:x['created_at'],reverse=True)
for p in pending_sorted:
    print('pending_id',p['payment_request_id'],'from',p['sender']['name'],'amount',p['amount'],'created_at',p['created_at'])

# approve all
results=[]
for p in pending_sorted:
    pid=p['payment_request_id']
    try:
        r=apis.venmo.approve_payment_request(payment_request_id=pid,access_token=token)
        results.append((pid,'approved',r))
        print('Approved',pid,'->',r)
    except Exception as e:
        results.append((pid,'error',str(e)))
        print('Error approving',pid,'->',e)

print('Approve results summary:',{s:sum(1 for x in results if x[1]==s) for s in set(x[1] for x in results)})

# verify none pending remain
pending_after=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    page=apis.venmo.show_received_payment_requests(access_token=token,status='pending',page_index=page_index,page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    pending_after.extend(page)
    page_index+=1
print('Pending after approvals',len(pending_after))
